# Test data

Frozen copies used by tests, so tests don't change when the samples in `examples/` evolve.

- `playbooks/job-evaluation.yaml`: the one-stage Job evaluation, version 0.1.
- `playbooks/internal-request.yaml`: the internal request sample.
- `playbooks/other-work.yaml`: the catch-all Other work, version 0.1 (the demo business uses it).
- `playbooks/monthly-return.yaml`: the recurring Monthly return, version 0.1 (the demo business uses it).

Master-data kinds come from `examples/masters` (tests use the current ones).
